name: agentcentral
description:
agentcentral is a hosted MCP server for Amazon sellers that connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients to Amazon Ads, Seller Central, inventory, orders, catalog, rankings, finance, and fulfillment data.

It provides fast reads from pre-materialized Amazon data, scoped API keys, OAuth-based Amazon connections, encrypted tokens, per-tenant isolation, and guarded write tools with audit log
